overloadMerges.note: The docs render two syntax lines, but the second (setName-first) line is just a shorter way of writing the same call when aTable is omitted -- aTable is already optional in the first line, so both lines describe one overload where aTable and setName are independently optional.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table whose records to highlight; the table of the current form if omitted.

params.name: setName
params.description: Name of the set of records to highlight; the UserSet set if omitted.
If passed, disables the automatic scroll of the list to reveal highlighted records.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Highlights (visually selects) the records of a set (or the UserSet if setName is omitted) in a list form, without changing the current selection.

constraints: For an included subform, this command only has an effect if the subform's Selection Mode property is set to Multiple; otherwise use GOTO SELECTED RECORD to highlight a single line.
